# @wordpress/env

> 标签: docker, environment, gutenberg, playground, wordpress

## 简介

A zero-config, self contained local WordPress environment for development and testing.

- 官网：https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/tree/HEAD/packages/env#readme
- 源码仓库：git+https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg.git
